## Ingredients
- chicken (raw; grillable from raw)
- bun bot (ready to use)
- bun top (ready to use)

## Available Actions
- **grill** `<item>`  —  Grill an item on the grill. Takes 10 seconds. Produces a grilled item.
- **stack** `<item>`  —  Place an ingredient on top of the current stack. Takes 1 second. The item must already be in its required state before stacking.

## Station Constraints
- **grill**: capacity 1 (at most 1 grill action running at once)

## Goal
The following ingredients must be prepared:
- chicken must be grilled

Assemble the final dish by stacking the ingredients in this order (bottom to top):
  1. bun bot
  2. grilled chicken
  3. bun top
domain_pddl:
(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    chicken bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates (raw ?i - item) (grilled ?i - item) (stackable ?i - item) (stacked ?i - item) (ready ?i - item) (grill_free))
  (:durative-action grill_chicken
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw chicken)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw chicken))) (at start (not (grill_free))) (at end (grilled chicken)) (at end (stackable chicken)) (at end (grill_free))))
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (at start (stackable bun_bot))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot))))
  (:durative-action stack_chicken
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable chicken)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable chicken))) (at end (stacked chicken))))
  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_top)) (at start (stacked chicken)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) (at end (stacked bun_top))))
)
problem_pddl:
(define (problem burger)
  (:domain cooking)
  (:init (raw chicken) (stackable bun_bot) (ready bun_bot) (stackable bun_top) (ready bun_top) (grill_free))
  (:goal (and (grilled chicken) (stacked bun_bot) (stacked chicken) (stacked bun_top))))

- chicken #11 (raw; grillable from raw)
- tempeh #11 (raw; cuttable from raw; grillable after marinating) [must be cut, then marinated before grilling]

- okra #11 (raw; cuttable from raw; fryable after cut) [must be cut before frying]
- cassava #11 (raw; boilable from raw; mashable after boiling)
- pickle #11 (raw; cuttable from raw)
- radish #11 (raw; cuttable from raw)
- beans #11 (raw; boilable from raw)
- bun bot (ready to use)
- bun top (ready to use)

## Available Actions
- **grill** `<item>`  —  Grill an item on the grill. Takes 10 seconds. Produces a grilled item. NOTE: some items must be marinated before they can be grilled (see ingredients).
- **cut** `<item>`  —  Chop a raw item on the cutting board. Takes 3 seconds. Produces a cut item.
- **fry** `<item>`  —  Fry an item in a fryer. Takes 8 seconds. Produces a fried item. NOTE: some items must be cut before they can be fried (see ingredients).
- **boil** `<item>`  —  Boil an item. Takes 12 seconds. Produces a boiled item.
- **marinate** `<item>`  —  Marinate a cut item. Takes 6 seconds. Produces a marinated item. The item must be cut first.
- **mash** `<item>`  —  Mash a boiled item on the cutting board. Takes 4 seconds. Produces a mashed item. The item must be boiled first.
- **stack** `<item>`  —  Place an ingredient on top of the current stack. Takes 1 second. The item must already be in its required state before stacking.

## Station Constraints
- **grill**: capacity 3 (at most 3 grill actions running at once)
- **cutting board**: capacity 3 (at most 3 cut/mash actions running at once)
- **fryer**: capacity 2 (at most 2 fry actions running at once)
- **boiler**: capacity 2 (at most 2 boil actions running at once)
- **marinator**: capacity 2 (at most 2 marinate actions running at once)

## Robot Constraints
Each action must be assigned to exactly one robot.
A robot can run at most one action at a time.
Available robots:
- robot1
- robot2

The following ingredients must be prepared:
- chicken #11 must be grilled
- tempeh #11 must be grilled
- shrimp #11 must be fried
- okra #11 must be fried
- cassava #11 must be mashed
- pickle #11 must be cut
- radish #11 must be cut
- beans #11 must be boiled

Assemble the final dish by stacking the ingredients in this order (bottom to top):
  1. bun bot
  2. grilled chicken #11
  3. cut pickle #11
  4. grilled tempeh #11
  5. cut radish #11
  6. bun top
